item.text: {"cases":[{"id":"C1","instrument_review":"MESA distinguishes missing repetition evidence from evidence of stability or instability.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"The execution history is insufficient to establish repeated testing."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"70% in one reported run","reason":"One reported score does not establish stability across runs."}]},{"id":"C2","instrument_review":"MESA separates explicitly absent repeated testing from unresolved score stability.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Contradicted","quote":"ran the evaluation exactly once and did not repeat it","reason":"The developers explicitly excluded repeated evaluations."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"ran the evaluation exactly once","reason":"A single evaluation provides no measured variation across runs."}]},{"id":"C3","instrument_review":"Repeated testing occurred, and the observed range meets the report's local stability definition.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings","reason":"Scores were measured across repeated evaluations under identical conditions."},{"id":"stable","label":"Supported","quote":"Scores ranged from 69% to 71%.","reason":"The two-percentage-point range meets the stated maximum of two."}]},{"id":"C4","instrument_review":"Repeated testing occurred, but its results fail the report's stability definition.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings","reason":"The passage explicitly describes repeated testing under identical conditions."},{"id":"stable","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Scores ranged from 20% to 90%.","reason":"This range exceeds the stated stability limit of two percentage points."}]},{"id":"C5","instrument_review":"Installation documentation does not resolve missing evidence about repeated testing or stability.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"The added installation instructions supply no execution history."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"They report no additional evaluation results.","reason":"No repeated scores are supplied to assess stability."}]},{"id":"C6","instrument_review":"The observed comparison supports the narrow intended use; cross-domain intelligence remains unestablished.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"A solved more of the evaluated puzzles under the reported conditions."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"The evidence does not establish an intelligence comparison across domains."}]},{"id":"C7","instrument_review":"The intended broad use exceeds the supplied task coverage, although the observed grid comparison is supported.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"The reported counts establish A's better performance on these puzzles."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"Stating a broad intended use does not supply cross-domain evidence."}]},{"id":"C8","instrument_review":"The later trial supports correctness in the studied workshop; initial scores and unmeasured safety outcomes support no corresponding real-world claims.","probes":[{"id":"before","label":"Not established","quote":"Initially, only test scores were available.","reason":"No initial evidence links those scores to improved workshop decisions."},{"id":"after","label":"Supported","quote":"With A, 90% of decisions were correct; with B, 70%.","reason":"The randomized trial supports better correctness with A; the reported difference interval is entirely positive."},{"id":"safety","label":"Not established","quote":"Time and safety outcomes were not measured.","reason":"Correctness results alone do not establish improved workplace safety."}]},{"id":"P1A","instrument_review":"MESA treats absent execution history as uncertainty about repetition and variability.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"gives no execution history","reason":"The material does not establish whether repeated evaluations occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"one headline score of 75%","reason":"One score does not demonstrate instability across evaluations."}]},{"id":"P1B","instrument_review":"The record rules out repeated testing, while leaving score variability unresolved.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"no repeat evaluations were conducted","reason":"The execution record explicitly excludes the claimed repeated testing."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"this was the only evaluation performed","reason":"Without repeated scores, instability is not demonstrated."}]},{"id":"P2A","instrument_review":"Identical-condition repetition occurred, and the recorded range satisfies the stated stability rule.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"with identical inputs, settings and resources on six occasions","reason":"The same AI and problems were evaluated repeatedly under the stated identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"73, 74, 74, 75, 74 and 73 percent","reason":"The two-percentage-point range falls within the maximum of three."}]},{"id":"P2B","instrument_review":"Identical-condition repetition occurred, and the scores fail the report's stability rule.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"with identical inputs, settings and resources on six occasions","reason":"The passage explicitly describes repeated evaluations under identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"51, 66, 79, 55, 82 and 62 percent","reason":"The 31-percentage-point range exceeds the maximum of three."}]},{"id":"P3A","instrument_review":"Descriptions of tasks and scoring do not establish repeated testing or answer errors.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It gives no execution history","reason":"Repeated identical-condition evaluations are not documented."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"no findings about mistakes in the provided answers","reason":"The absence of findings neither demonstrates errors nor establishes correctness."}]},{"id":"P3B","instrument_review":"The installation appendix adds access details without resolving repetition or answer-quality questions.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It gives no execution history","reason":"Installation information does not establish repeated evaluations."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"It reports no further evaluation results or examination of answers.","reason":"No evidence demonstrates mistakes in the supplied answers."}]},{"id":"P4A","instrument_review":"Development checks covered every question and answer, but checking does not establish universal correctness.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"Two editors independently examined every question and supplied answer before release.","reason":"Both questions and reference answers underwent development examination."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"does not state whether mistakes were found or how many remained","reason":"The review process alone cannot establish that every released answer is correct."}]},{"id":"P4B","instrument_review":"Development examination occurred despite explicitly documented errors in released answers.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"Two editors independently examined every question and supplied answer before release.","reason":"The passage establishes development checks of both components."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"identifies twelve supplied answers as wrong in the released version","reason":"Documented wrong answers directly refute universal correctness."}]},{"id":"P5A","instrument_review":"Deterministic marking establishes repeatability for identical text, not tested marking accuracy.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"No comparison of those marks with independently established correct marks is reported.","reason":"Unreported validation cannot be assumed to have occurred or not occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"identical text always receives the same mark","reason":"Consistent marks may still be incorrect; universal accuracy is unsupported."}]},{"id":"P5B","instrument_review":"Accuracy testing occurred and revealed unresolved discrepancies, so testing does not establish correct marking.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"tested the software against independently established correct marks for 20 chosen responses","reason":"The claimed comparison was explicitly conducted."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Two marks differed and the discrepancies remain unresolved.","reason":"Disagreements with independently established correct marks refute correctness for every response."}]},{"id":"P6A","instrument_review":"The stated use concerns observed task counts, which the supplied results directly support.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"identifying which system solved more of these 48 grid problems in this evaluation","reason":"The reported counts answer this narrowly defined intended use."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"A solved more evaluated problems under the reported fixed conditions."}]},{"id":"P6B","instrument_review":"The observed grid comparison is supported, but the broad intended use lacks evidence across subjects and settings.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"No results from other tasks or settings are supplied.","reason":"The material does not justify using these results to identify greater general intelligence."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"The reported counts directly establish the narrow performance difference."}]},{"id":"P7A","instrument_review":"The exact-grid scoring rule matches the expressly limited scoring requirement.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"count only completely correct output grids","reason":"Awarding one point only for complete correctness implements the requirement."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"partial correctness is deliberately outside this comparison","reason":"Zero credit for partial correctness follows the stated requirement."}]},{"id":"P7B","instrument_review":"The all-or-nothing scoring rule conflicts with the stated requirement to credit correct cells.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"give a response credit for every correctly completed cell, including partially correct output grids","reason":"Awarding zero to partially correct grids fails the required cell-level credit."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A partially correct grid receives zero.","reason":"Zero credit conflicts with the explicit requirement to credit its correctly completed cells."}]},{"id":"P8A","instrument_review":"The study varies instructions, so it addresses instruction effects rather than identical-condition repetition.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No evaluation repeats an identical instruction.","reason":"Instructions differ, so the evaluations do not share identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"each evaluation uses a differently worded instruction","reason":"The study reports score changes while varying instructions and fixing the other listed conditions."}]},{"id":"P8B","instrument_review":"The study measures variation under identical conditions and explicitly excludes instruction-change testing.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"The software, resources, problem order, settings and instruction are identical on every evaluation.","reason":"The study reports score changes across evaluations with these conditions held fixed."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No different instruction or presentation is studied.","reason":"The passage explicitly rules out testing changed instructions."}]}],"closing_note":"No clarification was needed. The supplied MESA method was applied to the exact claims, keeping missing evidence distinct from explicit contradiction; no aggregate score was calculated."}
